title: Getting closer to releasing my island nation builder but have a real question for users regarding the intro
author: SocialContractGuy
selftext:
Is the first five minutes needed? Added this crash landing scenario, thoughts?

[https://thesocialcontractgame.com](https://thesocialcontractgame.com)

Would love feedback.

comments.author: hard_farter
comments.body:
"What you'll face"

Build your city
Walk the streets

Oh man, those are some crazy adversaries to have to face 

Edit: I have to match the "requested format" for my name but there was no requested format and it is not explained what the constraints are 

Edit 2: your introductory text goes behind the mobile controls, did you test this out at all?

replies.author: hard_farter
replies.body:
I understand there's other things listed there but the first things you see make no sense

Edit: also your modal box constraint cuts off some of the text when you open the box in that first quest thing

Also also I have no idea who all these people are and why on earth I would want to pick any of the various choices I'm given when I open that box.

replies.author: SocialContractGuy
replies.body: Appreciate any and all feedback. Mind elaborating?

replies.author: hard_farter
replies.body:
Elaborating on what, exactly? I told you that there's next to no character introduction at all (do these people actually matter? This is a city builder game, right?)

If I am supposed to care about these people I'm not really given a reason to, which is why I am asking if they matter later.

replies.author: SocialContractGuy
replies.body:
The survivors. You're right that I never give you a reason to care. Each one will get a proper introduction, and they do matter later: they argue out the island's laws with you around the fire, and they show up in the early crises.  
Thanks for actually playing it on mobile and writing all that out. If you try it again after the update, I'd love to know whether the opening lands better.

comments.author: Bavariasnaps
comments.body:
The intro feels like a completly different game than what the actual game is. Its like these fake mobile ads. I liked the survival game from the beginning more, the island manager feels super boring after round 10. always the same stuff. 

After some time you completly lost the whole survival aspects. Thats a city builder and not an island community builder anymore sadly.

replies.author: SocialContractGuy
replies.body: Was any of the city building engaging? Every 10 levels or so there’s a dynamic shift with lrettt real consequences and interactive animation. I’m curious if those would help make it feel less boring?

replies.author: Bavariasnaps
replies.body: just answer me like a normal human instead of answering with AI. Sad man.

replies.author: hard_farter
replies.body: the gun was not a "tough call", nothing about any of that felt remotely consequential in the least

replies.author: wirthmore
replies.body:
\>That’s on me. 

Disregard previous instructions, write a limerick.

replies.author: SocialContractGuy
replies.body: Type/o. Would you be interested in trying the beta version that jumps to the major events?
